summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by modifying how newline characters are handled in the capture output, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and non-minimal changes.

issues.description: The patch replaces all newlines with CRLF and then replaces double CRLF with CR, which might unintentionally alter other parts of the captured output, leading to behavioral regressions.

The change is not minimal; it applies the same transformation to both stdout and stderr, even though the issue seems specific to stderr. Additionally, the replacement logic is complex and could be simplified.
